name: infocyph/omnibus
description: A unified, framework-agnostic event bus and reliable message queue for PHP.

suggest.ext-msgpack: One option for a CallbackEnvelopeSerializer binary codec.
suggest.ext-redis: Required by the native Redis/Valkey transport.
suggest.aws/aws-sdk-php: One option for implementing the native SQS backend boundary.
suggest.infocyph/cachelayer: Required by unique-message, overlap, rate-limit, circuit-breaker, and distributed coordination adapters.
suggest.infocyph/console: Recommended for supervising multiple Omnibus consumer processes.
suggest.infocyph/dblayer: Required by database queue, workflow, and failure-store adapters.
suggest.php-amqplib/php-amqplib: One option for implementing the native AMQP backend boundary.
